source.notes: Stainless spec from the last SambaNova/sambanova-python .stats.yml that published one (commit 6e9c54e, 2026-06-25). Base https://api.sambanova.ai/v1.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model ID to use (e.g. gpt-oss-120b).  See available [models](https://docs.sambanova.ai/docs/en/models/sambacloud-models)

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: A list of messages comprising the conversation so far.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the chat completion.  The total length of input tokens and generated tokens is limited by  the model's context length.

max_completion_tokens.title: Max Completion Tokens
max_completion_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the chat completion.  The total length of input tokens and generated tokens is limited by  the model's context length.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: What sampling temperature to use, determines the degree of randomness in the response.  between 0 and 2, Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random,  while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.  Is recommended altering this, top_p or top_k but not more than one of these.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Cumulative probability for token choices. An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered. Is recommended altering this, top_k or temperature but  not more than one of these.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Amount limit of token choices. An alternative to sampling with temperature, the model considers the results of the first K tokens with higher probability.  So 10 means only the first 10 tokens with higher probability are considered. Is recommended altering this, top_p or temperature but not more than one of these.

presence_penalty.title: Presence Penalty
presence_penalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics. Not currently implemented; accepted for API compatibility

frequency_penalty.title: Frequency Penalty
frequency_penalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim. Not currently implemented; accepted for API compatibility

do_sample.title: do_sample
do_sample.description: If true, sampling is enabled during output generation. If false, deterministic decoding is used.

stop.title: Stop
stop.description: Sequences where the API will stop generating tokens. The returned text will not contain the stop sequence.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: If set, partial message deltas will be sent. Tokens will be sent as data-only  [server-sent events](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events#Event_stream_format) as they become available, with the stream terminated by a `data: [DONE]` message.

stream_options.title: StreamOptions
stream_options.description: Options for streaming response. Only set this when setting stream as true

include_usage.title: Include Usage
include_usage.description: Whether to include the usage metrics in a final chunk or not

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: An object specifying the format that the model must output.   Setting to `{ "type": "json_object"}` enables JSON mode,    which will check the message the model generates is valid JSON.  **Important:** when using JSON mode, you **must** also instruct the model to produce JSON yourself  via a system or user message. Setting to `{ "type": "json_schema", "json_schema": {<your_schema>}"}` enables JSON schema mode,    which will check the message the model generates is valid object of type <your_schema>.  Setting to `{ "type": "text"}` is equivalent to the default plain text generation

reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort
reasoning_effort.description: Value specifying the amount of reasoning the model is allowed to do, increasing it will increase the number of output reasoning tokens generated by the model, but will improve quality of the responses. allowed values are 'low', 'medium', 'high'

tool_choice.title: Tool Choice
tool_choice.description: Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model.  `none` means the model will not call any tool and instead generates a message.  `auto` means the model can pick between generating a message or calling one or more tools.  `required` means the model must call one or more tools.  Specifying a particular tool via `{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "my_function"}}` forces  the model to call that tool.

parallel_tool_calls.title: Parallel Tool Calls
parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether to enable parallel function calling during tool use, This is not yet supported by our models.

tools.title: tools
tools.description: A list of tools the model may call.  Use this to provide a list of functions the model may generate JSON inputs for.

chat_template_kwargs.title: Chat Template Kwargs
chat_template_kwargs.description: A dictionary of additional keyword arguments to pass into the chat template.  Use this to provide extra context or parameters that the model's chat template  can process. Keys must be strings; values may be any valid JSON type.

logprobs.title: Logprobs
logprobs.description: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log  probabilities of each output token returned in the `content` of `message`.

top_logprobs.title: Top Logprobs
top_logprobs.description: An integer between 0 and 20 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token  position, each with an associated log probability. `logprobs` must be set to `true` if this parameter is used.

n.title: N
n.description:
How many completions to generate for each prompt.
**Note:** Because this parameter generates many completions, it can quickly consume your token quota. Use carefully and ensure that you have reasonable settings for `max_tokens`.

logit_bias.title: Logit Bias
logit_bias.description: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the generation. Accepts a JSON object that maps tokens (specified by their  token ID in the model tokenizer) to an associated bias value from -100 to 100. Mathematically, the bias is added to the logits generated by the model prior to sampling.  Values between -1 and 1 should decrease or increase likelihood of selection; values like -100 or 100 should result in a ban or exclusive selection of the relevant token.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description:
If specified, our system will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same `seed` and parameters should return the same result.
Determinism is not guaranteed, and you should refer to the `system_fingerprint` response parameter to monitor changes in the backend.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant developed by SambaNova systems

ChatCompletionResponse.description: chat completion response returned by the model

id.title: Id

system_fingerprint.description: Backend configuration that the model runs with.

message.content: In madam moon's silver glow,  Aha, a palindrome to know,  Radar spins, a circular tale,  Level heads prevail, without fail.  A man, a plan, a canal, Panama!  Able was I ere I saw Elba,  A Santa at NASA, a curious sight,  Do geese see God, in the pale moonlight?  Mr. Owl ate my metal worm,  Do nine men interpret? Nine men, I nod,  Never odd or even, a palindrome's might,  Madam, in Eden, I'm Adam.  Aibohphobia, a fear to confess,  A palindrome's symmetry, I must address,  Refer, a word that reads the same,  A palindrome's beauty, in its circular game.  In the stillness of the night,  Ava, a palindrome, shining bright,  Hannah, a name that reads the same,  A palindrome's magic, in its circular flame.  Note: Please keep in mind that creating a poem using palindromes can be a challenging task,  and the resulting poem may not be as cohesive or flowing as one that doesn't rely on palindromes.  However, I hope you enjoy the attempt!
Hello! How can I assist you today?

ChatCompletionStreamResponse.title: Chat Completion Stream Response
ChatCompletionStreamResponse.description: streamed chunk of a chat completion response returned by the model

choices.title: Choices
choices.description: A list of chat completion choices.

created.title: Created
created.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the chat completion was created.

id.title: Id
id.description: A unique identifier for the chat completion.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model used for the chat completion.

system_fingerprint.title: System fingerprint
system_fingerprint.description: Backend configuration that the model runs with.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model ID to use (e.g. gpt-oss-120b).  See available [models](https://docs.sambanova.ai/docs/en/models/sambacloud-models)

input.title: Input
input.description: Text input to the model, or a structured list of input items representing the full conversation turn. A plain string is equivalent to a single user message.

oneOf.title: Text input
oneOf.description: A plain text input equivalent to a user-role message.

oneOf.title: Input item list
oneOf.description: An ordered list of input items (messages, tool calls, tool results, etc.).

examples.content: What is the weather in San Francisco?

examples.content: What is the weather in San Francisco?

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Inserts a system (or developer) message as the first item in the model's context. Equivalent to a system-role message prepended to input[].

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: If true, the response is delivered as server-sent events (SSE).

max_output_tokens.title: Max Output Tokens
max_output_tokens.description: Upper bound on the number of tokens the model may generate, including visible output tokens and reasoning tokens.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Controls randomness in generation. Range: 0–2. It is recommended to alter this, top_p, or top_k but not more than one at a time.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Nucleus sampling cutoff. Range: 0–1. It is recommended to alter this, temperature, or top_k but not more than one at a time.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Limits sampling to the top K most probable tokens. It is recommended to alter this, top_p, or temperature but not more than one at a time.

top_logprobs.title: Top Logprobs
top_logprobs.description: Number of top log-probability entries to return per output token. Null means log probabilities are not returned.

frequency_penalty.title: Frequency Penalty
frequency_penalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim. Not currently implemented; accepted for API compatibility and echoed in the response.

presence_penalty.title: Presence Penalty
presence_penalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics. Not currently implemented; accepted for API compatibility and echoed in the response.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Tools available to the model. Only type: "function" is supported; all other tool types are filtered server-side.

parallel_tool_calls.title: Parallel Tool Calls
parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the model may issue multiple tool calls in parallel within one turn.

max_tool_calls.title: Max Tool Calls
max_tool_calls.description: Maximum number of tool calls the model may make in a single response turn. Not currently implemented; accepted for API compatibility.

text.title: Text
text.description: Response format configuration. Supports plain text, json_object, and json_schema.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Reasoning configuration for models that support it. Ignored on non-reasoning models.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort level. "low" is faster with less depth; "high" is deeper at higher token cost.

user.title: User
user.description: Included for API compatibility, but only echoed back in response

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Included for API compatibility, but not supported

store.title: Store
store.description: SambaNova is stateless - this field is accepted for API compatibility but has no effect. Always echoed back as false.

truncation.title: Truncation
truncation.description: Accepted for API compatibility and echoed in the response. Context truncation behavior is not currently configurable via this field in SambaNova.

previous_response_id.title: Previous Response ID
previous_response_id.description: Not supported. SambaNova is stateless and does not maintain server-side conversation state. Accepted for API compatibility but ignored; clients must supply the full conversation history in input[].

background.title: Background
background.description: Accepted for API compatibility and echoed back in the response. Has no effect on server behavior.

service_tier.title: Service Tier
service_tier.description: Accepted for API compatibility and echoed back in the response. Has no effect on server behavior.

ResponseResponse.title: Response Response
ResponseResponse.description: A response object returned by POST /responses (non-streaming). Contains the model's output items, echoed input parameters, lifecycle metadata, and token usage.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle status of the response. "completed" means the model finished successfully. "failed" means an error occurred during generation. "incomplete" means generation was cut short (e.g. max_output_tokens reached).

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the response was created.

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the response finished generating.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model ID used to generate this response.

output.title: Output
output.description: Ordered array of output items generated by the model. Items may be of type "message", "reasoning", or "function_call".

error.title: Error
error.description: In-band error object present when status is "failed". Null when the response completed successfully.

incomplete_details.title: Incomplete Details
incomplete_details.description: Present when status is "incomplete". Describes why generation stopped before completion (e.g. max_output_tokens reached).

reason.description: The reason why the response is incomplete.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: The system instructions echoed from the request, or null if none were provided.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: The temperature value used for this response.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: The top_p value used for this response.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: The top_k value used for this response.

frequency_penalty.title: Frequency Penalty
frequency_penalty.description: The frequency_penalty value echoed from the request. Not currently implemented; accepted for API compatibility

presence_penalty.title: Presence Penalty
presence_penalty.description: The presence_penalty value echoed from the request. Not currently implemented; accepted for API compatibility

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Tool definitions available to the model for this response.

parallel_tool_calls.title: Parallel Tool Calls
parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether parallel tool calls were enabled.

max_tool_calls.title: Max Tool Calls
max_tool_calls.description: The max_tool_calls value echoed from the request.

text.title: Text
text.description: The text format configuration (structured output mode) used for this response.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: The reasoning configuration used for this response.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: The reasoning effort level that was applied for supported models.

truncation.title: Truncation
truncation.description: The truncation value echoed from the request.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: The metadata echoed from the request.

max_output_tokens.title: Max Output Tokens
max_output_tokens.description: The max_output_tokens limit echoed from the request.

top_logprobs.title: Top Logprobs
top_logprobs.description: The top_logprobs value echoed from the request.

previous_response_id.title: Previous Response ID
previous_response_id.description: Not supported. Always null. SambaNova is stateless; use input[] to supply full conversation history.

store.title: Store
store.description: Whether the response was stored server-side. SambaNova is stateless - always false.

service_tier.title: Service Tier
service_tier.description: The service tier used to process this request, as reported by the server.

user.title: User
user.description: The user, echoed back from request.

content.text: User wants a three-sentence bedtime story about a unicorn. Provide three sentences, gentle, bedtime. Should be concise.

Under a moonlit canopy of twinkling stars, a silver-mane unicorn tiptoed into the meadow, leaving a trail of soft, glowing stardust behind each gentle step. She whispered a lullaby to the sleepy flowers, and they swayed in rhythm, their petals folding like tiny blankets around the night. As the world hushed, the unicorn curled around a sleepy child's dream, gifting them a night of sweet, sparkling adventures until sunrise.

ResponseStreamEvent.title: Response Stream Event
ResponseStreamEvent.description: Top-level discriminated union of all Server-Sent Events emitted during a streaming `POST /responses` call. Discriminated by the `type` field. Events arrive in `sequence_number` order and cover the full lifecycle of a response: creation, content generation (text, reasoning, function call arguments), and completion.

MessageCreateRequest.title: Message Create Request
MessageCreateRequest.description: Request body for `POST /messages`. Wire-compatible with the official Anthropic Messages API. Required fields: `model`, `max_tokens`, `messages`.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model ID to use (e.g. gpt-oss-120b).  See available [models](https://docs.sambanova.ai/docs/en/models/sambacloud-models)

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate. The combined input + output token count is bounded by the model's context window.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature in `[0.0, 2.0]`. Higher values produce more random output, lower values more deterministic. Adjust only one of `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k`.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Nucleus sampling. Considers tokens with cumulative probability mass up to `top_p`.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Top-k sampling. Considers only the K most likely tokens at each step. Set to 0 to disable.

stop_sequences.title: Stop Sequences
stop_sequences.description: Custom strings that, when generated, cause the model to stop.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: If true, the response is a sequence of Server-Sent Events whose payloads conform to `MessageStreamEvent`.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Tool definitions the model may call.

tool_choice.description: Controls how the model selects from `tools`.

container.title: Container
container.description: Existing code-execution container ID to reuse. **In v1**: silently dropped

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Non-streaming response from `POST /messages`. Wire-compatible with the official Anthropic Messages API.

stop_sequence.description: The matched stop sequence that triggered termination. Present when `stop_reason` is `stop_sequence`; `null` otherwise.

MessageStreamEvent.title: Message Stream Event
MessageStreamEvent.description: Discriminated union of SSE events emitted during a streaming `POST /messages` call. Event order: `message_start` -> (`content_block_start` -> `content_block_delta`×N -> `content_block_stop`) × blocks -> `message_delta` -> `message_stop`. A `ping` may appear at any point; an `error` event terminates the stream.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role of the messages author, in this case `system`.

content.title: Content
content.description: The contents of the system message.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role of the messages author, in this case `user`.

content.title: Content
content.description: The contents of the user message.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role of the messages author, in this case `assistant`.

content.title: Content
content.description: The contents of the assistant message.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Reasoning (returned by reasoning models like gpt oss)

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Channel (returned by reasoning models like gpt oss)

tool_calls.title: Tool Calls
tool_calls.description: The tool calls generated by the model.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role of the messages author, in this case `tool`.

content.title: Content
content.description: The contents of the tool message.

ResponseFormatJSONSchema.title: ResponseFormatJSONSchema
ResponseFormatJSONSchema.description: Specifies that the model should produce output conforming to a given JSON schema.

json_schema.name: User
json_schema.description: JSON schema for a simple user object

ResponseFormatJSONObject.title: ResponseFormatJSONObject
ResponseFormatJSONObject.description: Specifies that the model should produce output as a raw JSON object.

ResponseFormatText.title: ResponseFormatText
ResponseFormatText.description: Specifies that the model should produce output as plain text. This value is not supported yet in the chat compeltions api, if this behavior is desired do not set response format.

function.title: Function
function.description: Specifies a tool the model should use. Use it to force the model to call that specific tool.

name.title: Name
name.description: the name of the tool expected to be used by the model

type.description: The type of the tool. only `function` is supported.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of the tool. Currently, only `function` is supported.

EnableThinking.title: Enable Thinking
EnableThinking.description: Enables the model's internal reasoning or "thinking" mode,  if supported by the chat template (deepseek models).

finish_reason.title: Finish Reason
finish_reason.description: The reason the model stopped generating tokens.  Will be `stop` if the model hit a natural stop point or a provided stop sequence,  `length` if the maximum number of tokens specified in the request was reached,  `tool_calls` if the model called a tool.

index.title: Index
index.description: The index of the choice in the list of choices

logprobs.title: Logprobs
logprobs.description: Returns the log probability of each generated token, indicating the model's confidence.  Setting logprobs=true and top_logprobs (up to 5) reveals the likelihood of chosen tokens

Usage.title: Usage
Usage.description: Usage metrics for the completion, embeddings,transcription or translation request

completion_tokens.title: Completion Tokens
completion_tokens.description: number of tokens generated in completion

completion_tokens_after_first_per_sec.title: Completion Tokens After First Per Sec
completion_tokens_after_first_per_sec.description: completion tokens per second after first token generation

completion_tokens_after_first_per_sec_fi.title: Completion Tokens After First Per Sec First Ten
completion_tokens_after_first_per_sec_fi.description: completion tokens per second after first token generation first ten

completion_tokens_after_first_per_sec_gr.title: Completion Tokens After First Per Sec Graph
completion_tokens_after_first_per_sec_gr.description: completion tokens per second after first token generation

end_time.title: End Time
end_time.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the generation finished.

is_last_response.title: Is Last Response
is_last_response.description: whether or not is last response, always true for non streaming response

prompt_tokens.title: Prompt Tokens
prompt_tokens.description: number of tokens used in the prompt sent

start_time.title: Start Time
start_time.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the generation started.

time_to_first_token.title: Time To First Token
time_to_first_token.description: also TTF, time (in seconds) taken to generate the first token

time_to_first_token_graph.title: Time To First Token Graph
time_to_first_token_graph.description: Time (in seconds) to first token, adjusted for graph rendering. May differ slightly from time_to_first_token.

stop_reason.title: Stop Reason
stop_reason.description: The reason generation stopped (e.g. "stop", "length"). Mirrors the choice-level finish_reason but reported at the usage level.

reasoning_tokens.title: Reasoning Tokens
reasoning_tokens.description: Number of tokens consumed by the model's internal reasoning process. Only present on reasoning-capable models.

total_latency.title: Total Latency
total_latency.description: total time (in seconds) taken to generate the full generation

total_tokens_per_sec.title: Total Tokens Per Sec
total_tokens_per_sec.description: tokens per second including prompt and completion

finish_reason.title: Finish Reason
finish_reason.description: The reason the model stopped generating tokens.  Will be `stop` if the model hit a natural stop point or a provided stop sequence,  `length` if the maximum number of tokens specified in the request was reached,  `tool_calls` if the model called a tool.

index.title: Index
index.description: The index of the choice in the list of choices

logprobs.title: Logprobs
logprobs.description: Returns the log probability of each generated token, indicating the model's confidence.  Setting logprobs=true and top_logprobs (up to 5) reveals the likelihood of chosen tokens

ResponseInputItem.title: Response Input Item
ResponseInputItem.description: A single item in the input[] array. Can be a message, a function call, a function call result, or a reasoning trace replayed from a prior turn. When building multi-turn conversations, pass all items from the previous response output[] back as input[] items (including reasoning items) so the model has full context. Discriminated by the "type" field.

ResponseTool.title: Response Tool
ResponseTool.description: A tool definition passed to the model via the tools[] array. Only type "function" is supported; other tool types are filtered server-side.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of tool. Always "function".

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the function to be called.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of what the function does. Used by the model to decide when and whether to call it.

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: The parameters the function accepts, described as a JSON Schema object. Omit or set to null for functions that take no parameters.

strict.title: Strict
strict.description: When true, the model is instructed to generate arguments that strictly conform to the provided JSON schema. Not currently enforced by SambaNova accepted for API compatibility and echoed back as null in the response.

example.name: get_weather
example.description: Get the current weather for a given location.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. San Francisco, CA

ResponseToolChoiceOption.title: Response Tool Choice Option
ResponseToolChoiceOption.description: Controls which tool (if any) the model calls. String values: "none" disables tool calls; "auto" lets the model decide; "required" forces at least one tool call. To force a specific function, provide a ResponseNamedToolChoice object.

oneOf.title: Tool choice mode
oneOf.description: String shorthand for tool selection behavior.

ResponseFormatConfiguration.title: Response Format Configuration
ResponseFormatConfiguration.description: Controls the format of the model's output for the Responses API text.format field. "text" returns plain text (default). "json_object" returns a raw JSON object. "json_schema" enforces structured output matching a provided JSON Schema definition (fields are flat — no json_schema wrapper key).

ResponseOutputItem.title: Response Output Item
ResponseOutputItem.description: A single item in the output[] array returned by the model. Can be a message (with text or tool call content), a function call request, or a reasoning trace. Discriminated by the "type" field.

ResponseUsage.title: Response Usage
ResponseUsage.description: Token usage statistics for this response.

input_tokens.title: Input Tokens
input_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the input, including conversation history and any system instructions.

output_tokens.title: Output Tokens
output_tokens.description: Number of tokens generated in the output, including visible text and any reasoning tokens.

total_tokens.title: Total Tokens
total_tokens.description: Total tokens consumed by this request (input + output).

cached_tokens.title: Cached Tokens
cached_tokens.description: Number of input tokens served from the prompt cache. Cached tokens are billed at a reduced rate.

reasoning_tokens.title: Reasoning Tokens
reasoning_tokens.description: Number of tokens consumed by the model's internal reasoning process. Only present on reasoning-capable models.

start_time.title: Start Time
start_time.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of when generation started.

end_time.title: End Time
end_time.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of when generation finished.

time_to_first_token.title: Time To First Token
time_to_first_token.description: Time in seconds from request receipt to first output token (TTFT).

total_latency.title: Total Latency
total_latency.description: Total time in seconds taken to generate the full response.

output_tokens_per_sec.title: Output Tokens Per Sec
output_tokens_per_sec.description: Output token throughput (tokens/second) for this response.

output_tokens_after_first_per_sec.title: Output Tokens After First Per Sec
output_tokens_after_first_per_sec.description: Output token throughput measured after the first token was emitted. Excludes the time-to-first-token latency from the rate calculation.

acceptance_rate.title: Acceptance Rate
acceptance_rate.description: Speculative decoding acceptance rate. Ratio of draft tokens accepted by the verifier model. Higher values indicate better speculation efficiency.

is_last_response.title: Is Last Response
is_last_response.description: Always true for non-streaming responses. For streaming, true only on the final chunk that carries usage.

ResponseCreatedEvent.title: Response Created Event
ResponseCreatedEvent.description: Emitted as the first SSE event when a streaming response begins. The embedded response object has status `in_progress` and an empty `output` array. Clients can use this event to capture the response `id` for later correlation.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter for ordering events within a streaming response. Starts at 0 for `response.created`.

ResponseInProgressEvent.title: Response In Progress Event
ResponseInProgressEvent.description: Emitted when the response transitions to the `in_progress` state, immediately after `response.created`. The embedded response object still has an empty `output` array; model generation has not yet produced any content.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter for ordering events within a streaming response.

ResponseOutputItemAddedEvent.title: Response Output Item Added Event
ResponseOutputItemAddedEvent.description: Emitted when a new output item (message, function call, or reasoning) is added to the response output array. The item has `status: in_progress` and may have empty content at this point.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter for ordering events within a streaming response.

output_index.description: Index of the output item in the response `output` array.

ResponseContentPartAddedEvent.title: Response Content Part Added Event
ResponseContentPartAddedEvent.description: Emitted when a new content part is added to an output item's content array. The part's `text` is empty at this point; subsequent `response.output_text.delta` or `response.reasoning_text.delta` events carry the incremental content.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter for ordering events within a streaming response.

item_id.description: ID of the output item to which this content part belongs.

output_index.description: Index of the parent output item in the response `output` array.

content_index.description: Index of this content part within the output item's `content` array.

ResponseReasoningTextDeltaEvent.title: Response Reasoning Text Delta Event
ResponseReasoningTextDeltaEvent.description: Emitted for each incremental chunk of reasoning text generated by the model. Accumulate `delta` values in order to reconstruct the full reasoning text.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter for ordering events within a streaming response.

item_id.description: ID of the reasoning output item this delta belongs to.

output_index.description: Index of the reasoning output item in the response `output` array.

delta.description: The incremental chunk of reasoning text.

example.delta: User wants a three-sentence bedtime story about a unicorn. Provide three sentences, gentle, bedtime. Should be concise.

ResponseReasoningTextDoneEvent.title: Response Reasoning Text Done Event
ResponseReasoningTextDoneEvent.description: Emitted when a reasoning content part has been fully generated. The `text` field contains the complete accumulated reasoning text (equivalent to concatenating all preceding `response.reasoning_text.delta` values). Structural mirror of `response.reasoning_text.delta` with `text` instead of `delta`.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter for ordering events within a streaming response.

item_id.description: ID of the reasoning output item this content belongs to.

output_index.description: Index of the reasoning output item in the response `output` array.

text.description: The full accumulated reasoning text for this content part.

example.text: User wants a three-sentence bedtime story about a unicorn. Provide three sentences, gentle, bedtime. Should be concise.

ResponseOutputTextDeltaEvent.title: Response Output Text Delta Event
ResponseOutputTextDeltaEvent.description: Emitted for each incremental chunk of assistant message text. Accumulate `delta` values in order to reconstruct the full output text.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter for ordering events within a streaming response.

item_id.description: ID of the message output item this delta belongs to.

output_index.description: Index of the message output item in the response `output` array.

content_index.description: Index of the content part within the output item's `content` array.

delta.description: The incremental chunk of output text.

annotations.description: Annotations attached to this delta chunk, if any.

logprobs.description: Log probability information for the tokens in this delta, if requested.

example.delta: Under a moonlit canopy of twinkling stars, a silver-mane unicorn tiptoed into the meadow, leaving a trail of soft

ResponseOutputTextDoneEvent.title: Response Output Text Done Event
ResponseOutputTextDoneEvent.description: Emitted when an output text content part has been fully generated. The `text` field contains the complete accumulated output text (equivalent to concatenating all preceding `response.output_text.delta` values). Structural mirror of `response.output_text.delta` with `text` instead of `delta`.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter for ordering events within a streaming response.

item_id.description: ID of the message output item this content belongs to.

output_index.description: Index of the message output item in the response `output` array.

content_index.description: Index of the content part within the output item's `content` array.

text.description: The full accumulated output text for this content part.

annotations.description: All annotations attached to this text part.

logprobs.description: Log probability information for all tokens, if requested.

example.text: Under a moonlit canopy of twinkling stars, a silver-mane unicorn tiptoed into the meadow, leaving a trail of soft, glowing stardust behind each gentle step. She whispered a lullaby to the sleepy flowers, and they swayed in rhythm, their petals folding like tiny blankets around the night. As the world hushed, the unicorn curled around a sleepy child's dream, gifting them a night of sweet, sparkling adventures until sunrise.

ResponseFunctionCallArgumentsDeltaEvent.title: Response Function Call Arguments Delta Event
ResponseFunctionCallArgumentsDeltaEvent.description: Emitted for each incremental chunk of function call arguments JSON generated by the model. Accumulate `delta` values in order to reconstruct the full arguments string. The accumulated result will be a valid JSON string once the corresponding `response.function_call_arguments.done` event is received.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter for ordering events within a streaming response.

item_id.description: ID of the function call output item this delta belongs to.

output_index.description: Index of the function call output item in the response `output` array.

delta.description: The incremental chunk of the function call arguments JSON string.

ResponseFunctionCallArgumentsDoneEvent.title: Response Function Call Arguments Done Event
ResponseFunctionCallArgumentsDoneEvent.description: Emitted when a function call's arguments have been fully generated. The `arguments` field contains the complete JSON arguments string (equivalent to concatenating all preceding `response.function_call_arguments.delta` values). Structural mirror of `response.function_call_arguments.delta` with `arguments` instead of `delta`.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter for ordering events within a streaming response.

item_id.description: ID of the function call output item.

output_index.description: Index of the function call output item in the response `output` array.

arguments.description: The complete JSON arguments string for the function call.

ResponseContentPartDoneEvent.title: Response Content Part Done Event
ResponseContentPartDoneEvent.description: Emitted when a content part has been fully generated. The `part` field contains the complete content for this part (equivalent to the state after accumulating all preceding delta events). Structural mirror of `response.content_part.added`.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter for ordering events within a streaming response.

item_id.description: ID of the output item this content part belongs to.

output_index.description: Index of the parent output item in the response `output` array.

content_index.description: Index of this content part within the output item's `content` array.

ResponseOutputItemDoneEvent.title: Response Output Item Done Event
ResponseOutputItemDoneEvent.description: Emitted when an output item has been fully generated and its status transitions to `completed`. The `item` field contains the complete output item including all accumulated content. Structural mirror of `response.output_item.added`.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter for ordering events within a streaming response.

output_index.description: Index of the output item in the response `output` array.

As the world hushed, the unicorn curled around a sleepy child's dream, gifting them a night of sweet, sparkling adventures until sunrise.

ResponseCompletedEvent.title: Response Completed Event
ResponseCompletedEvent.description: Emitted as the final SSE event when a streaming response has been fully generated. The embedded response object has `status: completed`, a fully populated `output` array, and a populated `usage` object. Structural mirror of `response.created`.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing counter for ordering events within a streaming response.

content.text: The user wants to extract event info from a sentence. We need to output a JSON in the prescribed format.

role.description: Conversational role. `user` for the human-side turn, `assistant` for prior model output.

MessageSystemPrompt.title: Message System Prompt
MessageSystemPrompt.description: System prompt for the conversation. Accepts either a single string (most common) or an array of text blocks (used when individual segments need `cache_control` markers). Multiple text blocks are joined with newlines and prepended to the conversation as a `role: system` message.

MessageMetadata.title: Message Metadata
MessageMetadata.description: Free-form metadata attached to the request. Currently only `user_id` Additional fields are accepted but ignored.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: External identifier for the end-user making the request. Mapped internally to the Chat Completions `user` field.

MessageThinkingConfig.title: Message Thinking Config
MessageThinkingConfig.description: Controls Anthropic-style extended thinking. **In v1**: only `type:"disabled"` is silently accepted as a no-op; `type:"enabled"` and `type:"adaptive"` return a 400 `invalid_request_error` (`unsupported_parameter`).

MessageTool.title: Message Tool
MessageTool.description: User-defined function tool definition. Only custom function tools are supported (Anthropic's `type:"custom"` style or the absent-type Beta style). Anthropic-hosted server tools (`web_search`, `code_execution`, `bash`, `text_editor`, `memory`, `tool_search` variants) return 400 `unsupported_tool_type` if sent.

type.description: Tool-type discriminator. May be omitted (defaults to custom) or set to `custom`. Other values return 400 `unsupported_tool_type`.

description.description: Human-readable description of when the tool should be used.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's expected input. Required by the Anthropic spec; accepted as optional by SambaNova.

cache_control.description: Silently dropped on tool definitions (only content and system cache markers participate in caching).

MessageToolChoice.title: Message Tool Choice
MessageToolChoice.description: How the model should choose from the provided tools.

MessageOutputContentBlock.title: Message Output Content Block
MessageOutputContentBlock.description: Typed content block in the model's response.

MessageStopReason.title: Message Stop Reason
MessageStopReason.description: Reason the model stopped generating. SambaNova emits `end_turn`, `max_tokens`, `tool_use`, and `stop_sequence`. The remaining values are defined for Anthropic SDK type-parity but never returned: `pause_turn` (server-tool loop limit, not produced); `refusal` (content filter, not exposed); `model_context_window_exceeded` (folded to `max_tokens`).

MessageStopDetails.title: Message Stop Details
MessageStopDetails.description: Refusal stop details. Anthropic compatibility only — `refusal` is never emitted as a stop_reason by SambaNova (content filtering is not exposed at the API layer).

input_tokens.description: Total tokens in the prompt (system + messages + tools).

output_tokens.description: Total tokens generated by the model.

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Tokens written to prompt cache. Absent in v1; emitted once prompt caching wiring lands (CP-2897).

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Tokens read from prompt cache. Absent in v1; emitted once prompt caching wiring lands (CP-2897).

server_tool_use.description: Server-tool usage metrics (e.g. `web_search_requests`). Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server tools, so this field is never emitted.

service_tier.description: Service tier that processed the request. Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova is single-tier and never emits this field.

cache_creation.description: Anthropic SDK alias for cache write metrics. Always `null` in SambaNova responses; use `cache_creation_input_tokens` instead.

inference_geo.description: Geographic region that served the request. Anthropic compatibility only - SambaNova does not expose geo routing, always `null`.

MessageContainer.title: Message Container
MessageContainer.description: Code-execution container reference. Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side code execution, so this field is never emitted on responses.

MessageStartEvent.title: Message Start Event
MessageStartEvent.description: First event of a stream. Carries the initial Message envelope (empty `content[]`, `stop_reason: null`) and token usage from prompt processing.

MessageContentBlockStartEvent.title: Content Block Start Event
MessageContentBlockStartEvent.description: Opens a new content block. One per block in `content[]`.

index.description: Zero-based index of the block within `content[]`.

MessageContentBlockDeltaEvent.title: Content Block Delta Event
MessageContentBlockDeltaEvent.description: Incremental update to the currently open content block.

index.description: Zero-based index of the block within `content[]`.
Zero-based index of the block within `content[]`.

MessageDeltaEvent.title: Message Delta Event
MessageDeltaEvent.description: Penultimate event of the stream. Carries the final `stop_reason`, optional `stop_sequence`, and final usage counts.

stop_sequence.description: Custom stop sequence that triggered termination. Field is emitted but value is always `null` in v1 (backend collapses `StopSequenceHit` and `EndOfText` into the same finish_reason).

stop_details.description: Refusal stop details. Field is emitted but value is always `null` in v1 — `refusal` is not produced as a stop_reason.

MessageStopEvent.title: Message Stop Event
MessageStopEvent.description: Final event of the stream. No fields beyond `type`.

MessagePingEvent.title: Message Ping Event
MessagePingEvent.description: Keepalive heartbeat. May appear at any point in the stream.

MessageStreamErrorEvent.title: Message Stream Error Event
MessageStreamErrorEvent.description: Streamed error envelope. Terminates the stream.

JSONSchema.title: JSONSchema
JSONSchema.description: A JSON Schema definition the model's structured output. Follows standard JSON Schema syntax.

strict.title: Strict

name.description: The name of the function to be called. Must be a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of what the function does, used by the model to choose when and how to call the function.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role of the messages author

content.title: Content
content.description: The contents of the assistant message.

tool_calls.title: Tool Calls
tool_calls.description: The tool calls generated by the model.

CompletionResponseDelta.title: Completion Response Delta
CompletionResponseDelta.description: completion response delta chunk generated by streamed model responses.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role of the messages author

content.description: The contents of the assistant message.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Reasoning (returned by reasoning models like gpt oss)

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Channel (returned by reasoning models like gpt oss)

tool_calls.title: Tool Calls
tool_calls.description: The tool calls generated by the model.

ResponseMessage.title: Response Message
ResponseMessage.description: A message item. When used as input, id and status are optional. When present in output[], id and status are always set by the server.  Role "assistant" with content type "output_text" represents a prior model turn; user/system/developer turns use content type "input_text". Plain string content is accepted in all roles on input.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of this item. Always "message".

id.title: ID
id.description: Unique identifier for this message item. Always present on output items returned by the server. Not required when constructing input items.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role of the message. "assistant" is set by the server on output items. All four values are valid when constructing input items.

content.title: Content
content.description: The message content. Either a plain text string or an array of typed content parts. For assistant turns, array parts use type "output_text"; for user/system/developer turns, array parts use type "input_text".

oneOf.title: Content part array
oneOf.description: An array of typed content parts.

status.title: Status
status.description: Processing state of this item. Always set on output items returned by the server. Not required when constructing input items.

ResponseFunctionCall.title: Response Function Call
ResponseFunctionCall.description: A function call item used in both input[] and output[]. When present in output[], the model is requesting a tool call — id and status are always set by the server. When used in input[], it replays a prior function call from the conversation history for multi-turn tool loops.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of this item. Always "function_call".

id.title: ID
id.description: Unique identifier for this function call item. Always present on output items returned by the server. Required when replaying this item in a subsequent input[].

call_id.title: Call ID
call_id.description: The call ID generated by the model for this tool invocation. Used to correlate the function call with its corresponding function_call_output result.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the function the model wants to call.

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: A JSON string of the arguments to pass to the function, as generated by the model. Validate the arguments in your code before calling the function — the model may hallucinate parameters not defined in the schema.

status.title: Status
status.description: Processing state of this item. Always set on output items returned by the server. Not required when constructing input items.

ResponseFunctionCallOutput.title: Response Function Call Output
ResponseFunctionCallOutput.description: A tool result item used in input[] to return the output of a function call back to the model. Always input-only — the model never outputs function_call_output items. The call_id must match the id of the corresponding ResponseFunctionCall item from the prior model turn.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of this item. Always "function_call_output".

id.title: ID
id.description: Optional identifier for this output item.

call_id.title: Call ID
call_id.description: The call_id of the ResponseFunctionCall item this result corresponds to. Must match exactly.

output.title: Output
output.description: A JSON string containing the result of the function call. Returned to the model as the tool's response.

status.title: Status
status.description: Processing state. Optional when constructing input items.

ResponseOutputReasoning.title: Response Output Reasoning
ResponseOutputReasoning.description: A reasoning item emitted in output[] by models that expose their internal chain-of-thought. Contains the raw reasoning text the model produced before generating its final answer.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of this output item. Always "reasoning".

id.title: ID
id.description: Unique identifier for this reasoning item, assigned by the server.

status.title: Status
status.description: Processing state of this item. "in_progress" while streaming; "completed" when the full reasoning text has been emitted.

content.title: Content
content.description: The reasoning content parts. Each part has type "reasoning_text" and carries the raw thinking text. Absent when the item is first added (`response.output_item.added`); populated by `response.output_item.done`.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: A condensed summary of the reasoning content. Always returned as an empty array. Included for OpenAI API compatibility.

content.text: The user wants weather information for San Francisco. I'll call get_weather with location "San Francisco, CA".

ResponseNamedToolChoice.title: Response Named Tool Choice
ResponseNamedToolChoice.description: Forces the model to call a specific function. Pass this object as tool_choice to guarantee the model will invoke the named function.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of tool to force. Always "function".

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the function to call.

ResponseTextFormatText.title: Response Text Format Text
ResponseTextFormatText.description: Specifies that the model should produce output as plain text. This is the default.

type.title: Type
type.description: The format type. Always "text".

ResponseTextFormatJSONObject.title: Response Text Format JSON Object
ResponseTextFormatJSONObject.description: Specifies that the model should produce output as a raw JSON object. The model is not constrained to any specific schema.

type.title: Type
type.description: The format type. Always "json_object".

ResponseTextFormatJSONSchema.title: Response Text Format JSON Schema
ResponseTextFormatJSONSchema.description: Specifies that the model should produce structured output conforming to the provided JSON Schema. Unlike the Chat Completions API, the Responses API places name, schema, strict, and description directly on this object (not nested under a json_schema key).

type.title: Type
type.description: The format type. Always "json_schema".

name.title: Name
name.description: A name for the schema, used to identify it in the model's output.

description.title: Description
description.description: An optional description of the schema, used to guide the model.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: A JSON Schema object defining the structure the model's output must conform to. Typically includes "type", "properties", "required", and optionally "additionalProperties". Must be a valid JSON Schema.

strict.title: Strict
strict.description: When true, the model is instructed to produce output that strictly matches the schema. Not currently enforced by SambaNova — accepted for API compatibility.

example.name: event_extraction
example.description: Extract structured event information from text

ResponseStreamContentPart.title: Response Stream Content Part
ResponseStreamContentPart.description: A content part within a streaming event. Discriminated by `type`: `output_text` for assistant message content (reuses ResponseTextContent), `reasoning_text` for model reasoning (OSS extension).

ResponseAnnotation.title: Response Annotation
ResponseAnnotation.description: An annotation on a span of output text. Currently stubbed for OpenAI API compatibility — SambaNova does not produce annotations.

MessageInputContentBlock.title: Message Input Content Block
MessageInputContentBlock.description: Typed content block inside a message's `content` array.

MessageSystemTextBlock.title: Message System Text Block
MessageSystemTextBlock.description: A text segment within a structured `system` prompt array. Multiple text blocks are concatenated (with newlines) and prepended to the conversation as a `role: system` message at the chat-completions layer.

text.title: Text
text.description: Plain-text content of the system prompt segment.

MessageThinkingDisabled.title: Message Thinking Disabled
MessageThinkingDisabled.description: Disables Anthropic-style extended thinking. **In v1**: silently accepted as a no-op

MessageThinkingEnabled.title: Message Thinking Enabled
MessageThinkingEnabled.description: Enables Anthropic-style extended thinking with a fixed budget. **In v1**: returns a 400 `invalid_request_error` (`unsupported_parameter`).

budget_tokens.title: Budget Tokens
budget_tokens.description: Maximum tokens the model may spend on extended thinking before producing the final answer.

MessageThinkingAdaptive.title: Message Thinking Adaptive
MessageThinkingAdaptive.description: Enables Anthropic-style adaptive extended thinking. **In v1**: returns a 400 `invalid_request_error` (`unsupported_parameter`).

budget_tokens.title: Budget Tokens
budget_tokens.description: Optional upper bound on tokens spent on adaptive thinking. When omitted, the backend chooses based on prompt complexity.

MessageCacheControl.title: Message Cache Control
MessageCacheControl.description: Marks the preceding content block (or system text block) as a prompt- cache breakpoint. Marker positions are collected by the adapter; their wiring into the router's longest-prefix matching **In v1**: position is recorded; the `ttl` value is ignored.

type.title: Type
type.description: Cache breakpoint type. Only `ephemeral` is supported by Anthropic.

ttl.title: TTL
ttl.description: Optional time-to-live hint (e.g. `"5m"`, `"1h"`). **Currently ignored** in v1

MessageToolChoiceAuto.title: Message Tool Choice (Auto)
MessageToolChoiceAuto.description: Let the model decide whether and which tool to use.

MessageToolChoiceAny.title: Message Tool Choice (Any)
MessageToolChoiceAny.description: Require the model to call one of the provided tools.

MessageToolChoiceNone.title: Message Tool Choice (None)
MessageToolChoiceNone.description: Forbid the model from calling any tool.

MessageToolChoiceTool.title: Message Tool Choice (Tool)
MessageToolChoiceTool.description: Force the model to call a specific tool by name.

MessageOutputTextBlock.title: Message Output Text Block
MessageOutputTextBlock.description: Plain-text segment of the model's response.

MessageOutputToolUseBlock.title: Message Output Tool Use Block
MessageOutputToolUseBlock.description: Tool call generated by the model.

id.description: Unique identifier for this tool call.

name.description: Name of the tool being called.

input.description: Tool inputs as a JSON object.

caller.description: Anthropic routing metadata. Always `null` in SambaNova responses.

MessageOutputThinkingBlock.title: Message Output Thinking Block
MessageOutputThinkingBlock.description: Extended-reasoning trace from the model. Emitted by reasoning models.

MessageOutputRedactedThinkingBlock.title: Message Output Redacted Thinking Block
MessageOutputRedactedThinkingBlock.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not produce encrypted thinking output. Never emitted in responses.

MessageOutputServerToolUseBlock.title: Message Output Server Tool Use Block
MessageOutputServerToolUseBlock.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side tools. Never emitted in responses; defined for Anthropic SDK type-parity.

MessageOutputWebSearchToolResultBlock.title: Message Output Web Search Tool Result Block
MessageOutputWebSearchToolResultBlock.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side `web_search`. Never emitted in responses.

MessageOutputWebFetchToolResultBlock.title: Message Output Web Fetch Tool Result Block
MessageOutputWebFetchToolResultBlock.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side `web_fetch`. Never emitted in responses.

MessageOutputCodeExecutionToolResultBloc.title: Message Output Code Execution Tool Result Block
MessageOutputCodeExecutionToolResultBloc.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side `code_execution`. Never emitted in responses.

MessageOutputBashCodeExecutionToolResult.title: Message Output Bash Code Execution Tool Result Block
MessageOutputBashCodeExecutionToolResult.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side bash code execution. Never emitted in responses.

MessageOutputTextEditorCodeExecutionTool.title: Message Output Text Editor Code Execution Tool Result Block
MessageOutputTextEditorCodeExecutionTool.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side text-editor code execution. Never emitted in responses.

MessageOutputToolSearchToolResultBlock.title: Message Output Tool Search Tool Result Block
MessageOutputToolSearchToolResultBlock.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side `tool_search`. Never emitted in responses.

MessageOutputContainerUploadBlock.title: Message Output Container Upload Block
MessageOutputContainerUploadBlock.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not produce container_upload blocks (these come from Anthropic's server-side `code_execution` tool). Never emitted in responses.

MessageContentBlockDelta.title: Content Block Delta
MessageContentBlockDelta.description: Incremental update to an open content block.

MessageDeltaUsage.title: Message Delta Usage
MessageDeltaUsage.description: Final token accounting emitted in the closing `message_delta` event of a stream.

input_tokens.description: Total tokens in the prompt (echoed from `message_start`).

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Tokens written to prompt cache. Absent in v1;

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Tokens read from prompt cache. Absent in v1;

server_tool_use.description: Server-tool usage metrics. Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server tools, so this field is never emitted.

MessageError.title: Message Error
MessageError.description: Inner error object carried inside a `MessageErrorResponse`. The `type` value follows Anthropic's published error taxonomy.

type.title: Type
type.description: Error category. Values follow Anthropic's taxonomy.

AssistantToolCallFunction.title: AssistantToolCallFunction
AssistantToolCallFunction.description: The tool that the model called.

name.title: Name

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: The arguments to call the function with, as generated by the model in JSON format. Note that the model does not always generate valid JSON, and may hallucinate parameters not defined by your function schema. Validate the arguments in your code before calling your function.

FunctionParameters.title: Function Parameters
FunctionParameters.description: The parameters the functions accepts, described as a JSON Schema object. see the [JSON Schema reference](https://json-schema.org/understanding-json-schema/) for documentation about the format.  Omitting `parameters` defines a function with an empty parameter list.

ResponseContent.title: Response Content
ResponseContent.description: A typed content part used in both input and output message content arrays. Discriminated by the "type" field.

ResponseReasoningContent.title: Response Reasoning Content
ResponseReasoningContent.description: A single content part within a reasoning item's content[]. Contains the raw reasoning text produced by the model during its internal thinking process.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of this reasoning content part. Always "reasoning_text".

text.title: Text
text.description: The raw reasoning text generated by the model.

example.text: The user is asking about the weather. I should call the get_weather function with the location extracted from the message.

ResponseTextContent.title: Response Input Text Content
ResponseTextContent.description: A plain text content part for use inside a ResponseMessage.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of this content part. "input_text" for user, developer, and system roles,  and output_text for assistant messages.

text.title: Text
text.description: The text content of this part.

annotations.title: Annotations
annotations.description: Annotations on spans of this text part, such as URL or file citations. Only present on output_text parts returned by the server. Not currently produced by SambaNova — included for OpenAI API compatibility.

logprobs.title: Log Probs
logprobs.description: Log probability information for the output tokens. Only present on output_text parts when `top_logprobs` is set on the request.

ResponseUrlCitation.title: Response URL Citation
ResponseUrlCitation.description: A URL citation annotation on an output text span. Not currently implemented by SambaNova — included for OpenAI API compatibility.

type.title: Type
type.description: The annotation type. Always "url_citation".

title.title: Title
title.description: The title of the cited page.

start_index.title: Start Index
start_index.description: Character offset in the output text where the citation starts.

end_index.title: End Index
end_index.description: Character offset in the output text where the citation ends.

ResponseFileCitation.title: Response File Citation
ResponseFileCitation.description: A file citation annotation on an output text span. Not currently implemented by SambaNova — included for OpenAI API compatibility.

type.title: Type
type.description: The annotation type. Always "file_citation".

file_id.title: File ID
file_id.description: The ID of the cited file.

start_index.title: Start Index
start_index.description: Character offset in the output text where the citation starts.

end_index.title: End Index
end_index.description: Character offset in the output text where the citation ends.

MessageInputImageBlock.title: Message Input Image Block
MessageInputImageBlock.description: Image content. Only `source.type:"base64"` is supported in v1; URL sources return 400.

MessageInputToolUseBlock.title: Message Input Tool Use Block
MessageInputToolUseBlock.description: A prior assistant turn that invoked a tool.

id.description: Unique identifier for the tool call (used to correlate `tool_result`).

name.description: Name of the tool being invoked.

input.description: Tool inputs as a JSON object.

MessageInputToolResultBlock.title: Message Input Tool Result Block
MessageInputToolResultBlock.description: Result of a prior tool call.

tool_use_id.description: ID of the `tool_use` block this result corresponds to.

MessageInputServerToolUseBlock.title: Message Input Server Tool Use Block
MessageInputServerToolUseBlock.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side tools. A prior assistant turn that invoked an Anthropic-hosted tool (web_search, code_execution, etc.). Accepted in conversation history (e.g. replaying an Anthropic-served session) but never originates from a SambaNova response. New `server_tool_use`-type tool definitions on outgoing requests are rejected with 400 `unsupported_tool_type`.

MessageInputSearchResultBlock.title: Message Input Search Result Block
MessageInputSearchResultBlock.description: Inline search result content. In v1 the `title`, `source`, and `content[]` text are extracted into a text block; citations are dropped.

MessageInputWebSearchToolResultBlock.title: Message Input Web Search Tool Result Block
MessageInputWebSearchToolResultBlock.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side `web_search`. Echo of a prior Anthropic-served `web_search` tool call; accepted in conversation history but never originates from a SambaNova response. When present, only `title` (`url`) per result is extracted into a tool message.

MessageInputWebFetchToolResultBlock.title: Message Input Web Fetch Tool Result Block
MessageInputWebFetchToolResultBlock.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side `web_fetch`. Echo of a prior Anthropic-served `web_fetch` tool call; accepted in conversation history but never originates from a SambaNova response. When present, only the text content is extracted.

MessageInputCodeExecutionToolResultBlock.title: Message Input Code Execution Tool Result Block
MessageInputCodeExecutionToolResultBlock.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side `code_execution`. Echo of a prior Anthropic-served `code_execution` tool call; accepted in conversation history but never originates from a SambaNova response. When present, only `stdout`, `stderr`, and `return_code` are extracted; image output is dropped.

MessageInputBashCodeExecutionToolResultB.title: Message Input Bash Code Execution Tool Result Block
MessageInputBashCodeExecutionToolResultB.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side bash code execution. Echo of a prior Anthropic-served bash tool call; accepted in conversation history but never originates from a SambaNova response. Same lossy extraction as `code_execution_tool_result`.

MessageInputTextEditorCodeExecutionToolR.title: Message Input Text Editor Code Execution Tool Result Block
MessageInputTextEditorCodeExecutionToolR.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side text-editor code execution. Echo of a prior Anthropic-served text-editor tool call; accepted in conversation history but never originates from a SambaNova response. When present, only file content is extracted; metadata (line count, file type) is dropped.

MessageInputToolSearchToolResultBlock.title: Message Input Tool Search Tool Result Block
MessageInputToolSearchToolResultBlock.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not run server-side `tool_search`. Echo of a prior Anthropic-served `tool_search` tool call; accepted in conversation history but never originates from a SambaNova response. When present, an empty string is emitted to the tool message (no plain-text fields).

MessageInputThinkingBlock.title: Message Input Thinking Block
MessageInputThinkingBlock.description: Extended-reasoning trace from a prior assistant turn.

MessageInputRedactedThinkingBlock.title: Message Input Redacted Thinking Block
MessageInputRedactedThinkingBlock.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not produce encrypted thinking output. Echo of a prior Anthropic-served response where `thinking.display:"omitted"` was set. Accepted in conversation history but never originates from a SambaNova response. Silently dropped on input.

MessageInputContainerUploadBlock.title: Message Input Container Upload Block
MessageInputContainerUploadBlock.description: Anthropic compatibility only — SambaNova does not produce container_upload blocks (these come from Anthropic's server-side `code_execution` tool). Accepted in conversation history but never originates from a SambaNova response. Silently dropped on input.

MessageInputDocumentBlock.title: Message Input Document Block
MessageInputDocumentBlock.description: PDF or document content. **Returns 400** — no document-extraction pipeline available.

MessageContentBlockTextDelta.title: Content Block Text Delta
MessageContentBlockTextDelta.description: Incremental text chunk for an open text content block.

MessageContentBlockInputJsonDelta.title: Content Block Input JSON Delta
MessageContentBlockInputJsonDelta.description: Incremental fragment of a tool_use block's `input` JSON. Concatenate successive `partial_json` strings to reconstruct the full input object.

MessageContentBlockThinkingDelta.title: Content Block Thinking Delta
MessageContentBlockThinkingDelta.description: Incremental thinking chunk for an open thinking block. Emitted by reasoning models.

MessageContentBlockSignatureDelta.title: Content Block Signature Delta
MessageContentBlockSignatureDelta.description: Signature for an open thinking block. Emitted at the end of a thinking stream (paired with the closing `content_block_stop`); the `signature` value may be an empty string when the backend has no signed payload to attach.

ResponseImageContent.title: Response Image Content
ResponseImageContent.description: An image content part for use inside a ResponseMessage. Supported in input messages (user role). Provide a base64-encoded image as a data URL. external URLs not supported.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of this content part. Always "input_image".

image_url.title: Image URL
image_url.description: A base64-encoded image in data URL format or fully qualified URL (e.g. "data:image/png;base64,..."). Currently only base64-encoded image data is supported.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: The detail level for image processing. "auto" lets the model decide. "low" uses a fixed low-res tile. "high" enables high-res tiling.

ResponseAudioContent.title: Response Audio Content
ResponseAudioContent.description: An audio content part for use inside a ResponseMessage. Supported in input messages (user role). Provide base64-encoded audio data with the format.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of this content part. Always "input_audio".

format.title: Format
format.description: The format of the audio data.

ResponseVideoContent.title: Response Video Content
ResponseVideoContent.description: A video content part for use inside a ResponseMessage. Supported in input messages (user role). Provide a URL or base64-encoded video data.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of this content part. Always "input_video".

video_url.title: Video URL
video_url.description: A URL of the video or base64-encoded video data in data URL format (e.g. "data:video/mp4;base64,...").

MessageInputImageSourceBase64.title: Message Input Image Source (Base64)
MessageInputImageSourceBase64.description: Inline image data encoded as base64.

media_type.description: MIME type of the image bytes.

MessageInputImageSourceUrl.title: Message Input Image Source (URL)
MessageInputImageSourceUrl.description: HTTPS URL pointing to an image. **Returns 400 in v1** — URL fetching is blocked. Use `type:"base64"` instead.

MessageInputVideoSourceBase64.title: Message Input Video Source (Base64)
MessageInputVideoSourceBase64.description: Inline video data encoded as base64.

media_type.description: MIME type of the video bytes.

MessageInputVideoSourceUrl.title: Message Input Video Source (URL)
MessageInputVideoSourceUrl.description: HTTPS URL pointing to a video.

MessageInputToolResultContent.title: Message Input Tool Result Content
MessageInputToolResultContent.description: Content of a `tool_result` block. only text is forwarded.

api_key.description: SambaNova API key, sent as a bearer token in the `Authorization` header (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`). Default authentication scheme used by the SambaNova SDK across every OpenAI compatible endpoint.

x_api_key.description: SambaNova API key, sent in the `x-api-key` header. Accepted on the Messages API routes (`/messages`, `/messages/count_tokens`) so that callers can point the official Anthropic SDK at SambaNova by swapping `base_url` — no code changes. The credential value is the same as the bearer `api_key` scheme; only the transport differs.
x_api_key.name: x-api-key
